                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • R06
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                State updates must produce a new object or array. React compares by reference — the cheap check — so mutating in place is invisible to it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                And when the next value depends on the previous one, pass a function. Calling setCount(count + 1) twice in a row uses the same stale count both times, so you increment by one instead of two.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Mutation and the functional update
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                // WRONG - same array reference, no re-render
items.push(newItem); setItems(items)

// RIGHT - new array
setItems([...items, newItem])
setItems(items.filter(i => i.id !== id))
setItems(items.map(i => i.id === id ? { ...i, done: true } : i))

// WRONG - both reads see the same stale count, ends at +1
setCount(count + 1); setCount(count + 1)

// RIGHT - each receives the latest, ends at +2
setCount(c => c + 1); setCount(c => c + 1)

// Lazy init: the function runs ONCE, not on every render
const [state, setState] = useState(() => expensiveParse(raw))
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • R07
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Before reaching for context, try composition: pass the rendered element down as a prop or as children, so the intermediate layers never see the data at all.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  And derive rather than duplicate — a prop copied into state stops tracking the prop and immediately goes stale.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Composition beats drilling
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  // DRILLING - Layout and Sidebar do not care about `user`
<Layout user={u}><Sidebar user={u}><Profile user={u}/></Sidebar></Layout>

// COMPOSITION - the middle layers never touch it
<Layout sidebar={<Sidebar><Profile user={u}/></Sidebar>} />

// Defaults
function Btn({ size = 'md', ...rest }) {}   // prefer this
Btn.defaultProps = {}                        // deprecated for functions

// Derived, NOT copied into state
const fullName = `${first} ${last}`          // right
const [fullName, setFullName] = useState(`${first} ${last}`)  // stale
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • R08
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Synthetic events are a cross-browser wrapper delegated at the root container (the document in React 16, the root element since 17). Your onClick never actually lives on that button.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Event pooling — where the event object was reused and nulled out after the handler — was removed in React 17. You can now hold onto the event safely.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Delegation and its consequences
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    // This handler is NOT on the button. React listens at the root.
<button onClick={e => ...} />

// Consequence 1: a native listener that stops propagation before
// the root will kill your React handler
document.addEventListener('click', e => e.stopPropagation(), true)

// Consequence 2: mixing native + React ordering is confusing
// -> pick one, do not mix on the same element

// Pooling is GONE since 17 - this is now fine
const onChange = e => setTimeout(() => console.log(e.target.value))

// Escape hatch for the real event
onClick={e => e.nativeEvent}
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • R09
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      React renders false, null and undefined as nothing, but it happily renders the number 0 and the empty string. So && with a numeric left side leaks the number onto the page.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      For lists, always render an explicit empty state — a list that silently renders nothing looks like a bug to the user.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The falsy-render trap
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      // BUG - shows "0" when there are no items
{items.length && <List items={items} />}

// FIX
{items.length > 0 && <List items={items} />}
{items.length ? <List items={items} /> : <Empty />}

// Renders nothing: false, null, undefined
// Renders something: 0, NaN, ''

// Always handle the empty case explicitly
{loading ? <Skeleton/> : items.length ? <List/> : <Empty/>}
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • R10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A controlled input re-renders on every keystroke, which gives you instant validation and formatting at the cost of a render per character. An uncontrolled input keeps its value in the DOM and you grab it with a ref on submit — far cheaper, but you cannot react as the user types.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For a large form where you only need values at submit time, uncontrolled (or react-hook-form, which is uncontrolled underneath) is usually the right call.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Both, and the warning
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        // Controlled - React owns the value
<input value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} />

// Uncontrolled - the DOM owns it, read on demand
const ref = useRef(null)
<input defaultValue="" ref={ref} />
// ...later: ref.current.value

// The warning comes from value going undefined -> defined:
<input value={user?.name} />          // undefined on first render
<input value={user?.name ?? ""} />    // fix: never undefined
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • R11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The cost is not the input, it is everything that re-renders with it. Either isolate each field into its own component so only that one re-renders, or go uncontrolled and read values on submit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          react-hook-form is popular precisely because it is uncontrolled underneath — it subscribes with refs and re-renders almost nothing while you type.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Three levels of fix
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          // 1. Isolate - state lives in the field, parent does not re-render
function Field({ name, onCommit }) {
  const [v, setV] = useState('')
  return <input value={v} onChange={e=>setV(e.target.value)}
                onBlur={()=>onCommit(name, v)} />
}

// 2. Uncontrolled - read on submit
<form onSubmit={e => {
  const data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.currentTarget))
}}>

// 3. react-hook-form - refs, not state
const { register, handleSubmit } = useForm()
<input {...register('email')} />       // no re-render per keystroke
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • R12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The class model was time-based: mount, update, unmount. The hooks model is dependency-based: this effect belongs to these values, and re-runs whenever they change.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Once you think in synchronisation, the dependency array stops feeling like a chore and the cleanup function stops feeling optional.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Mapping, and why it misleads
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            componentDidMount          useEffect(fn, [])
componentDidUpdate         useEffect(fn, [deps])
componentWillUnmount       the cleanup: useEffect(() => () => {}, [])
shouldComponentUpdate      React.memo
getDerivedStateFromProps   just compute during render
componentDidCatch          still needs a class (or a library)

// The mapping misleads. This is NOT "on mount":
useEffect(() => { subscribe(roomId) }, [])   // BUG: never resubscribes

// It is "stay subscribed to the CURRENT room":
useEffect(() => {
  const s = subscribe(roomId)
  return () => s.close()
}, [roomId])
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • R13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              StrictMode deliberately double-invokes renders and mounts/unmounts/remounts effects in development only. It is surfacing two classes of bug: impure render functions, and effects with no cleanup.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              If your effect subscribes, opens a socket, or starts a timer and does not return a cleanup, StrictMode will show you the leak immediately — twice the listeners, twice the requests.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What StrictMode exposes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              useEffect(() => {
  const socket = connect(url)
  // Without this line, StrictMode leaves TWO sockets open
  return () => socket.close()
}, [url])

// Impure render - StrictMode makes this obviously wrong
function Bad() {
  items.push('x')          // mutating outside state during render
  return <List items={items} />
}

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Hooks
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Days 3-4, 6, 8-9, 12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Done whenYou can name the exact hook for a problem, and explain why the rules of hooks exist at the implementation level.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Studyreact.dev — Synchronizing with effects →react.dev — Rules of hooks →react.dev — You might not need an effect →
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              0/16
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • R14
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                State updates are queued and applied before the next render, not immediately. Reading the state variable right after setting it gives you the old value every time, and that surprises everyone once.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                React 18 also batches all updates, including those inside promises, timeouts and native handlers — before 18 it only batched inside React event handlers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Snapshot semantics
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                function handleClick() {
  setCount(count + 1)
  console.log(count)   // still the OLD value - this render's snapshot
}

// Object state does not merge (unlike class setState)
setUser({ name: 'Ann' })              // WRONG - drops every other field
setUser(u => ({ ...u, name: 'Ann' })) // RIGHT

// React 18: these are batched into ONE render
setTimeout(() => { setA(1); setB(2) }, 0)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • R15
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The effect runs after the commit, and re-runs whenever a dependency changes. The cleanup function runs before the next run and on unmount — that is where you unsubscribe, clear timers, and cancel in-flight work.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The dependency array is not a suggestion. Leave something out and you capture a stale value; put an object or function in without memoising it and you get an infinite loop.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Shape of a correct effect
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  useEffect(() => {
  const c = new AbortController()
  fetch(url, { signal: c.signal })
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(setData)
    .catch(e => { if (e.name !== 'AbortError') setError(e) })
  return () => c.abort()     // cleanup: cancel the previous request
}, [url])                    // re-runs when url changes

// [] = run once on mount
// no array = run after EVERY render (almost always a mistake)

// Infinite loop: options is a new object every render
useEffect(() => { load(options) }, [options])
// Fix: useMemo the object, or depend on its primitive fields
