                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • R16
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Every render creates fresh functions that close over that render props and state. If you register such a function once — in an interval, an event listener, a subscription — it keeps reading the values it was born with.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The symptom is always the same: a counter stuck at 1, or a handler acting on data from ten seconds ago. There are three fixes and it is worth knowing all three.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The bug and the three fixes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    // BUG - always logs 0. count is frozen in the first render.
useEffect(() => {
  const id = setInterval(() => console.log(count), 1000)
  return () => clearInterval(id)
}, [])

// FIX 1 - functional update, no need to read the value at all
setCount(c => c + 1)

// FIX 2 - include the dep, accept the re-subscribe
useEffect(() => { ... }, [count])

// FIX 3 - a ref that always holds the latest ("latest value" pattern)
const latest = useRef(count)
useEffect(() => { latest.current = count })
useEffect(() => {
  const id = setInterval(() => console.log(latest.current), 1000)
  return () => clearInterval(id)
}, [])
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    My notes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2↗

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • R17
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The most common unnecessary effect is derived state: watching a prop and copying a transformed version into state. That runs render → effect → setState → render, and the first render shows stale data.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Just compute it. And if it is genuinely expensive, wrap it in useMemo — still no effect, still one render.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Derived state without an effect
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      // WRONG - extra render, and stale for one frame
const [visible, setVisible] = useState([])
useEffect(() => { setVisible(items.filter(i => i.active)) }, [items])

// RIGHT - just derive it
const visible = items.filter(i => i.active)

// Expensive? memo it. Still no effect.
const visible = useMemo(() => heavyFilter(items), [items])

// Also NOT an effect: responding to a user action.
// That belongs in the event handler.
function onSubmit() { save(form); track('submitted') }
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      My notes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • R18
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Use a ref for two things: reaching a DOM node, and holding a mutable value that no render depends on — a timer id, a previous value, a websocket, a flag.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The rule that keeps you out of trouble: if changing it should update the UI, it is state. If nothing on screen reads it, a ref is cheaper and correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The two uses
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        // 1. DOM access
const inputRef = useRef(null)
useEffect(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), [])
<input ref={inputRef} />

// 2. Mutable value no render depends on
const timer = useRef(null)
const start = () => { timer.current = setInterval(tick, 1000) }
const stop  = () => clearInterval(timer.current)

// Do NOT read or write ref.current DURING render - it is not
// tracked, so React cannot know the output changed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • R19
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If your effect measures the DOM and then changes it — positioning a tooltip, correcting scroll — a normal effect lets the wrong position paint first, and the user sees a jump.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          That is the entire reason useLayoutEffect exists. For everything else, useEffect. And useLayoutEffect does not run on the server, so it warns during SSR.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          When the flicker is real
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          // Flickers: paints at 0,0 then jumps
useEffect(() => {
  setPos(measure(ref.current))
}, [])

// No flicker: measured and positioned before paint
useLayoutEffect(() => {
  setPos(measure(ref.current))
}, [])

// Rule: reading layout AND writing it back -> useLayoutEffect
//       everything else -> useEffect
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          My notes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2↗

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • R20
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Context solves prop drilling, not performance. When the provider value changes, every consumer re-renders regardless of which field it actually uses.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            So a single context holding user, theme, cart and settings means changing the cart re-renders the theme consumers too. That is fine for rarely-changing values and bad for anything that updates often.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The re-render trap
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            // BUG - new object identity every render, so EVERY consumer
// re-renders on every parent render, even if nothing changed
<Ctx.Provider value={{ user, setUser }}>

// FIX - stable identity
const value = useMemo(() => ({ user, setUser }), [user])
<Ctx.Provider value={value}>

// Good context: theme, locale, current user, feature flags
// Bad context: form state, anything changing per keystroke
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • R21
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The standard fix for context re-renders is two providers: one for the state, one for the setter or dispatch. Components that only write subscribe to the stable one and stop re-rendering entirely.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              If you need finer granularity than that, you want an external store with selectors — Zustand, Redux, or useSyncExternalStore.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Two contexts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              const StateCtx    = createContext(null)
const DispatchCtx = createContext(null)

function Provider({ children }) {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, init)
  return (
    <StateCtx.Provider value={state}>
      {/* dispatch identity is stable forever */}
      <DispatchCtx.Provider value={dispatch}>
        {children}
      </DispatchCtx.Provider>
    </StateCtx.Provider>
  )
}

// A button that only dispatches now never re-renders on state change
const dispatch = useContext(DispatchCtx)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Saved links

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2↗

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • R22
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Five useState calls that always change in the same combinations is a reducer trying to get out. It also removes a whole class of bug where you update three fields and forget the fourth.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                And dispatch has a stable identity forever, so passing it down never breaks memoisation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Grouped transitions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                // Five useStates that always move together -> one reducer
function reducer(s, a) {
  switch (a.type) {
    case 'submit':  return { ...s, status:'saving', error:null }
    case 'success': return { ...s, status:'done', data:a.data }
    case 'failure': return { ...s, status:'idle', error:a.error }
    default: throw new Error(`unknown action ${a.type}`)
  }
}
const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, { status:'idle' })

// Testable with zero React
expect(reducer({status:'idle'}, {type:'submit'}).status).toBe('saving')

// dispatch identity never changes -> safe to pass to memo'd children
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • R23
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  useMemo caches a value, useCallback caches a function. The point is almost never the cost of the calculation — it is that a new object or function every render breaks React.memo and re-triggers effects.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  So ask: who consumes this identity? If the answer is nobody, remove the memo.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Only useful with a consumer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  // Pointless - nothing downstream compares identity
const total = useMemo(() => a + b, [a, b])

// Useful - MemoChild can now actually skip
const handleSelect = useCallback(id => setSel(id), [])
<MemoChild onSelect={handleSelect} />

// Useful - stops an effect firing every render
const opts = useMemo(() => ({ id, mode }), [id, mode])
useEffect(() => subscribe(opts), [opts])

// Genuinely expensive computation is the third valid case
const parsed = useMemo(() => parseHugeCsv(raw), [raw])
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • R24
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    memo skips a re-render when the props are shallow-equal to last time. The trouble is that most props people pass are recreated every render, so the check never passes and the memo does nothing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    There are three usual culprits, and all three look completely innocent in the JSX.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The three silent failures
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    const Row = React.memo(function Row({ item, style, onClick, children }) { ... })

// 1. inline object - new identity every render
<Row style={{ margin: 4 }} />        -> useMemo it, or hoist it

// 2. inline arrow - new identity every render
<Row onClick={() => pick(id)} />     -> useCallback it

// 3. children - JSX creates a new element object every render
<Row>{<Icon />}</Row>                -> memo cannot help here

// Fixed
const style = useMemo(() => ({ margin: 4 }), [])
const onClick = useCallback(() => pick(id), [id])
<Row style={style} onClick={onClick} />
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • R25
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Extract when the same stateful logic appears twice, or when a component has so much wiring that the JSX is buried. The name must start with use so the lint rules apply.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Keep them focused and composable — a hook that takes ten options and returns fifteen values is a component in disguise.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Extraction and independence
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      function useDebounced(value, ms = 300) {
  const [v, setV] = useState(value)
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setTimeout(() => setV(value), ms)
    return () => clearTimeout(id)
  }, [value, ms])
  return v
}

// Each caller gets its OWN state - hooks share logic, not data
const a = useDebounced(q1)     // independent
const b = useDebounced(q2)     // independent

// Compose them
function useSearch(q) {
  const dq = useDebounced(q)
  return useQuery({ queryKey:['s', dq], queryFn:()=>search(dq) })
}
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2↗

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • R26
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Each component has a linked list of hook slots. On every render React walks that list in order — first useState call gets slot one, second gets slot two, and so on.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Call a hook conditionally and on some renders slot two is your effect and on others it is your state. That is why the rule is top level only, same order every time, and why the lint rule is not negotiable.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Why the order matters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        // BROKEN - on the render where isOpen is false, every hook
// after this one reads the wrong slot
if (isOpen) { const [x, setX] = useState(0) }

// FIX - hook unconditionally, branch on the value
const [x, setX] = useState(0)
if (isOpen) { ...use x... }

// Same problem, less obvious - an early return before a hook
if (!user) return null       // <- any hook below this is conditional
useEffect(...)               // BROKEN

// Fix: hooks first, early return after.
