                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • R27
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Before this hook, subscribing to an external store meant an effect plus state, which could show inconsistent values during concurrent rendering. useSyncExternalStore tells React about the subscription properly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          You give it three things: how to subscribe, how to read the current value, and how to read it on the server. It is what Zustand and Redux use under the hood.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Subscribing safely
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          const isOnline = useSyncExternalStore(
  // subscribe: returns an unsubscribe function
  cb => {
    window.addEventListener('online', cb)
    window.addEventListener('offline', cb)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', cb)
      window.removeEventListener('offline', cb)
    }
  },
  () => navigator.onLine,   // read current value on the client
  () => true                // read on the server (SSR)
)

// getSnapshot MUST return a cached value, not a new object
// each call - otherwise React loops forever.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • R28
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Use useId for any id that has to link two elements: label to input, input to its error message via aria-describedby. Never use it as a list key.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            useImperativeHandle narrows what a parent can do through a ref — expose focus(), not the whole DOM node.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The three
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            // useId - SSR-safe, stable across server and client
const id = useId()
<label htmlFor={`${id}-email`}>Email</label>
<input id={`${id}-email`} aria-describedby={`${id}-err`} />
<p id={`${id}-err`}>{error}</p>
// NOT for list keys - it is per-component, not per-item

// useImperativeHandle - expose a narrow API, not the node
const Input = forwardRef((props, ref) => {
  const inner = useRef(null)
  useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
    focus: () => inner.current.focus(),
    clear: () => { inner.current.value = '' }
  }), [])
  return <input ref={inner} {...props} />
})

// useDebugValue - a label in DevTools, dev only
useDebugValue(isOnline ? 'online' : 'offline')

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • R29
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              React Compiler analyses your components and inserts the equivalent of useMemo/useCallback automatically, only where it can prove it is safe. Manual memoisation mostly stops being something you write by hand.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              It only works on code that follows the rules — no mutation during render, no reading refs in render. Break the rules and it bails out on that component rather than producing wrong output.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What changes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              // You write this
function List({ items, onPick }) {
  const sorted = items.slice().sort(byName)
  return sorted.map(i => <Row key={i.id} item={i} onPick={onPick} />)
}

// The compiler emits caching around `sorted` and the JSX,
// keyed on whether `items` actually changed.

// It bails out (safely) on code that breaks the rules:
function Bad({ items }) {
  items.sort(byName)      // mutating a prop during render
  return ...
}

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Level 3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Application Architecture
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Days 15-20, 29-33
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Done whenGiven a feature spec, you can place every piece of state correctly and defend it, and design a component API someone else can use without reading its source.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              StudyTkDodo — Practical React Query →TanStack Query — important defaults →XState — state machines documentation →
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              0/21
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • R30
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The order to try: local state first, lift it only when a sibling needs it, context when it is genuinely app-wide and rarely changes, external store when many components need slices of it and you need to avoid re-rendering them all.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Each step up costs re-renders and coupling. Most we need Redux conversations are really we put this state four levels too high.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The escalation ladder
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. useState in the component            <- default
2. lift to the nearest common parent    <- a sibling needs it
3. useReducer                           <- several fields move together
4. context                              <- app-wide, changes rarely
                                           (theme, user, locale)
5. external store + selectors           <- many consumers, frequent
                                           updates, need isolation

// Cost of getting it wrong:
//   too low  -> prop drilling, awkward lifting later
//   too high -> whole subtrees re-render on every keystroke
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • R31
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A dropdown being open is client state: nobody else can change it, it cannot be stale, it cannot fail to load. A list of orders is server state: it has an owner elsewhere, it is out of date the moment you fetch it, and it needs loading, error and refetch handling.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Treating them the same is why so many Redux stores are 80% boilerplate for caching. Use a query library for server state and keep your own store small.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Two different problems
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  CLIENT STATE            SERVER STATE
is a modal open?        the list of orders
current form draft      the logged-in user profile
selected tab            search results
theme                   anything behind an API

owned by you            owned by the server
always correct          goes stale
never fails             can fail, needs retry
sync                    async, needs loading/error state

-> useState/useReducer  -> TanStack Query / SWR / RTK Query
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • R32
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Two problems live here. A race is a slow earlier request resolving last and clobbering fresher data. A waterfall is a parent fetching, rendering, and only then letting a child start its own fetch — so two 200ms calls take 400ms.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Cancel on cleanup to fix races. Hoist fetches to a route loader or start them in parallel to fix waterfalls.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Race and waterfall
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    // RACE FIX - the cleanup runs before the next effect
useEffect(() => {
  const c = new AbortController()
  fetch(`/search?q=${q}`, { signal: c.signal })
    .then(r => r.json()).then(setResults)
    .catch(e => { if (e.name !== 'AbortError') throw e })
  return () => c.abort()
}, [q])

// WATERFALL - child cannot start until parent finished rendering
<User />          // fetches user...
  <Orders />      // ...then this starts fetching

// FIX - start both at once
const [user, orders] = await Promise.all([getUser(), getOrders()])
// or fetch at the route level before rendering either
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • R33
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Fetch-on-render is the default and the slowest: render, then fetch, then render again, and any child repeats the cycle. Render-as-you-fetch kicks the request off first and renders into a Suspense boundary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Route-level loaders are the practical version — the router knows what the page needs before it starts rendering it, so the calls go out in parallel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Three timings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      // FETCH ON RENDER - waterfall, 3 sequential round trips
<Page/>   -> mounts -> fetch page
  <User/> -> mounts -> fetch user
    <Orders/> -> mounts -> fetch orders

// RENDER AS YOU FETCH - start first, render into Suspense
const resource = fetchUser(id)          // starts NOW
<Suspense fallback={<Skeleton/>}><Profile r={resource}/></Suspense>

// ROUTE LOADER - router fetches before rendering the route
{ path: '/order/:id',
  loader: ({params}) => Promise.all([getOrder(params.id), getUser()]),
  element: <Order /> }
// both requests in flight before any component mounts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • R34
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The default staleTime is 0, which means every mount refetches — that surprises people who think the cache is not working. Set it to how long the data is actually good for.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The query key is the cache key: anything the request depends on has to be in it, or you will show one user data under another user key.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The four things that matter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        useQuery({
  queryKey: ['orders', userId, page],   // EVERY input goes in here
  queryFn: () => getOrders(userId, page),
  staleTime: 60_000,   // trusted for 1 min - no refetch on remount
  gcTime: 5 * 60_000,  // kept in memory 5 min after last use
})

// Writes invalidate, they do not manually patch the cache
useMutation({
  mutationFn: createOrder,
  onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['orders'] })
})

// Optimistic update: apply now, roll back on error
onMutate: async (n) => {
  await qc.cancelQueries({ queryKey: ['orders'] })
  const prev = qc.getQueryData(['orders'])
  qc.setQueryData(['orders'], old => [...old, n])
  return { prev }
},
onError: (e, n, ctx) => qc.setQueryData(['orders'], ctx.prev)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2↗

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • R35
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If your store is mostly cached server data, you want a query library instead. RTK Query is that, built in, and it makes the classic Redux as a cache anti-pattern unnecessary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What Redux still gives you that a store like Zustand does not: a serialisable action log, middleware, and DevTools time travel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Slice and query
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          const cart = createSlice({
  name: 'cart',
  initialState: { items: [] },
  reducers: {
    // Immer: this LOOKS like mutation, produces a new state
    add(state, action) { state.items.push(action.payload) },
    clear(state) { state.items = [] }
  }
})
export const { add, clear } = cart.actions

// RTK Query - server state, cached, invalidated by tags
const api = createApi({
  endpoints: b => ({
    getOrders: b.query({ query: () => '/orders', providesTags:['Order'] }),
    addOrder:  b.mutation({ query: o => ({url:'/orders',method:'POST',body:o}),
                            invalidatesTags:['Order'] })
  })
})
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          My notes
