                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • R36
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Zustand is a store outside React that components subscribe to with a selector function. Select a primitive and you are done; select a new object and you have recreated the context problem.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            It uses useSyncExternalStore underneath, so it is concurrent-safe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Selectors and the object trap
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            const useStore = create((set) => ({
  count: 0,
  user: null,
  inc: () => set(s => ({ count: s.count + 1 })),
}))

// GOOD - re-renders only when count changes
const count = useStore(s => s.count)

// BAD - new object every render, so it ALWAYS re-renders
const { count, user } = useStore(s => ({ count: s.count, user: s.user }))

// FIX - separate selectors, or a shallow comparator
const count = useStore(s => s.count)
const user  = useStore(s => s.user)
// or: useStore(useShallow(s => ({count: s.count, user: s.user})))

// Actions never change identity - safe to pull out once
const inc = useStore(s => s.inc)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2↗

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • R37
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Nested API responses copied straight into state give you the same entity in several places. Update it in one and the others are quietly wrong.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Normalising means a map of id → entity, plus arrays of ids for ordering. It is exactly what a relational database does, for exactly the same reason.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Nested vs normalized
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              // PROBLEM - the same user object exists in three places
{ posts: [ { id:1, author: {id:9, name:'Ann'} },
           { id:2, author: {id:9, name:'Ann'} } ] }
// rename user 9 -> you must find and patch every copy

// NORMALIZED - one source of truth
{
  users:  { 9: { id:9, name:'Ann' } },
  posts:  { 1: { id:1, authorId:9 }, 2: { id:2, authorId:9 } },
  feed:   [1, 2]                      // order lives separately
}
// rename user 9 -> one write, everything re-reads it
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • R38
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The parent puts its state into a context that only its own children read. Consumers get to control the markup and ordering while the behaviour stays in the parent.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The tradeoff is an implicit dependency — a child used outside its parent must fail with a clear error, not a confusing null.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Compound component
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                const TabsCtx = createContext(null)

function Tabs({ children, defaultValue }) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(defaultValue)
  const v = useMemo(() => ({ value, setValue }), [value])
  return <TabsCtx.Provider value={v}>{children}</TabsCtx.Provider>
}
function Tab({ value, children }) {
  const ctx = useContext(TabsCtx)
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('<Tab> must be used inside <Tabs>')
  return <button aria-selected={ctx.value===value}
                 onClick={() => ctx.setValue(value)}>{children}</button>
}
Tabs.Tab = Tab

// The consumer writes markup, not a config object
<Tabs defaultValue="a">
  <Tabs.Tab value="a">First</Tabs.Tab>
  <Tabs.Tab value="b">Second</Tabs.Tab>
</Tabs>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • R39
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A combobox has roughly forty accessibility and keyboard requirements. A headless library gives you those as props to spread, with no markup or styles of its own.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  This is why Radix, Headless UI and TanStack exist: behaviour is genuinely hard and universal, appearance is genuinely specific to you.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Behaviour as props
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  // The hook owns behaviour + a11y; you own markup
const { getInputProps, getMenuProps, getItemProps, isOpen, highlighted }
  = useCombobox({ items, onSelectedItemChange })

<input {...getInputProps()} className="my-input" />
<ul {...getMenuProps()} className="my-menu">
  {isOpen && items.map((item, i) => (
    <li key={item.id}
        {...getItemProps({ item, index: i })}
        className={i === highlighted ? 'active' : ''}>
      {item.label}
    </li>
  ))}
</ul>

// What you would otherwise hand-write:
// role/aria-expanded/aria-activedescendant, arrow keys, Home/End,
// Escape, typeahead, focus return, screen-reader announcements
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • R40
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Render props caused the wrapper hell that hooks fixed; HOCs caused unclear prop origins and broken ref forwarding.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What survives: HOCs for cross-cutting concerns applied to a whole component (withErrorBoundary, withAuth, memo itself), and render props where the consumer must control the markup.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What each became
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    // Then: render prop
<Mouse render={({x,y}) => <Dot x={x} y={y} />} />
// Now: a hook
const { x, y } = useMouse()

// Then: HOC
export default withUser(withTheme(withRouter(Page)))   // wrapper hell
// Now: hooks
const user = useUser(); const theme = useTheme()

// STILL a HOC - wrapping from the outside
const Safe = withErrorBoundary(Page, { fallback: <Err/> })
export default memo(Row)

// STILL a render prop - consumer controls the markup
<Virtualizer>{(item) => <MyRow item={item} />}</Virtualizer>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • R41
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Modelling routes as a tree means shared chrome is declared once and data can be loaded per segment, in parallel, before rendering.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The practical win is that each route owns its own data and error boundary, so a failing panel does not take out the shell.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Route tree with per-route data
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      const routes = [{
  path: '/',
  element: <RootLayout />,        // stays mounted across children
  errorElement: <RootError />,
  children: [
    { index: true, element: <Home /> },
    { path: 'orders',
      element: <OrdersLayout />,
      loader: getOrders,          // starts before render
      children: [
        { path: ':id',
          element: <OrderDetail />,
          loader: ({params}) => getOrder(params.id),
          errorElement: <OrderError /> }   // scoped failure
      ]}
  ]
}]

// <Outlet /> is where the child route renders
function OrdersLayout() { return <><Filters/><Outlet/></> }
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • R42
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Treating unknown as unauthenticated bounces logged-in users to the login page on every refresh. Treating it as authenticated flashes private content.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Render nothing (or a skeleton) while the check is in flight, then redirect declaratively.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Three states, no flash
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        function RequireAuth({ children }) {
  const { user, status } = useAuth()
  const loc = useLocation()

  if (status === 'loading') return <FullPageSkeleton />   // the 3rd state
  if (!user) return <Navigate to="/login" state={{from: loc}} replace />
  return children
}

// WRONG - renders the private page, THEN redirects (flash)
useEffect(() => { if (!user) navigate('/login') }, [user])

// Better still: a route loader that redirects before rendering
loader: async () => {
  const u = await getSession()
  if (!u) throw redirect('/login')
  return u
}
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • R43
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Split at routes first, then at any component that pulls in a large dependency and is not shown immediately: modals, editors, charts, date pickers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Then hide the loading cost by prefetching on hover or when the link scrolls into view — by the time the click lands, the chunk is already there.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Split and prefetch
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          // Route level
const Settings = lazy(() => import('./routes/Settings'))

// Heavy leaf - 300KB chart lib, opened by 5% of users
const Chart = lazy(() => import('./Chart'))
{showChart && <Suspense fallback={<Box/>}><Chart/></Suspense>}

// Prefetch on hover - the chunk arrives before the click
<Link to="/settings"
      onMouseEnter={() => import('./routes/Settings')}
      onFocus={() => import('./routes/Settings')} />

// Prefetch on viewport
const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => {
  if (e.isIntersecting) import('./routes/Settings')
})
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • R44
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            An error boundary is the React version of try/catch, but only for the render phase of its children. Anything asynchronous has already left the render, so the boundary never sees it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Place them per region — one around the whole app means any error blanks the entire page. A failing sidebar should not take the checkout with it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            What it does and does not catch
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            CAUGHT                     NOT CAUGHT
render of a child          onClick handlers
lifecycle of a child       setTimeout / promises
constructor of a child     the boundary's OWN error
                           SSR

// Async errors need to be routed into state to be caught:
const [err, setErr] = useState(null)
if (err) throw err                       // now a boundary sees it
fetch(...).catch(setErr)

// Granularity matters
<ErrorBoundary fallback={<PageError/>}>
  <Header />
  <ErrorBoundary fallback={<WidgetError/>}>
    <RiskyWidget />        // fails alone, page survives
  </ErrorBoundary>
</ErrorBoundary>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • R45
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Suspense lets a component say I am not ready and React shows the nearest fallback instead. It is how lazy-loaded components and data-fetching integrations show loading states without you threading isLoading through everything.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Put the boundary where the loading state makes visual sense — too high and the whole page flashes a spinner, too low and you get a dozen independent spinners popping in.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Always paired
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              <ErrorBoundary fallback={<Failed />}>
  <Suspense fallback={<Skeleton />}>
    <Dashboard />
  </Suspense>
</ErrorBoundary>

// lazy() suspends until the chunk arrives
const Settings = lazy(() => import('./Settings'))

// Boundary placement decides what the user sees:
//   one at the page root  -> whole page flashes
//   one per region        -> header stays, panel shows a skeleton
