                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • R46
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Design the states per region rather than per page. A whole-page spinner throws away the parts that already loaded and makes the app feel slower than it is.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Skeletons should match the shape of the real content, or you get a layout shift when the data lands — which is a Core Web Vitals problem, not just a cosmetic one.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Per-region states
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                // Per page - everything blocks on the slowest call
if (loading) return <Spinner />

// Per region - header and filters render immediately
<Header />
<Suspense fallback={<FilterSkeleton/>}><Filters/></Suspense>
<Suspense fallback={<TableSkeleton rows={10}/>}><Table/></Suspense>

// All four states, explicitly
if (status === 'pending') return <TableSkeleton rows={10} />
if (status === 'error')   return <Retry onRetry={refetch} error={error} />
if (!rows.length)         return <Empty action={<AddFirst/>} />
return <Table rows={rows} />

// Skeleton must match the real layout, or CLS goes up when data lands
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • R47
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Define the schema once, infer the form type from it, and the same schema can validate on the server. Cross-field rules like confirm must match password belong in the schema, not scattered through handlers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Server-side errors need a route back into the form — setError maps an API validation response onto the right field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Schema-first form
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  const schema = z.object({
  email: z.string().email(),
  password: z.string().min(12),
  confirm: z.string(),
}).refine(d => d.password === d.confirm, {
  message: 'Passwords do not match', path: ['confirm']   // cross-field
})
type Form = z.infer<typeof schema>          // type comes free

const { register, handleSubmit, setError, formState:{errors} } =
  useForm<Form>({ resolver: zodResolver(schema) })

<input {...register('email')} aria-invalid={!!errors.email} />
{errors.email && <p role="alert">{errors.email.message}</p>}

// Map server validation back onto fields
catch (e) { setError('email', { message: e.fieldErrors.email }) }
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • R48
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The bugs in multi-step flows are always about invalid combinations — back from step 3 after an async submit, refresh mid-flow, double submit. A state machine makes those transitions explicit and rejects the rest.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    You do not need a library. A reducer with a transition table gets you most of the value.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Explicit transitions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    const machine = {
  details:  { NEXT: 'payment' },
  payment:  { NEXT: 'review', BACK: 'details' },
  review:   { SUBMIT: 'submitting', BACK: 'payment' },
  submitting: { OK: 'done', FAIL: 'review' },   // cannot go BACK
  done:     {}
}
function reducer(state, event) {
  const next = machine[state.step][event.type]
  return next ? { ...state, step: next, data: merge(state, event) } : state
}

// Illegal transitions are ignored by construction:
// no "back" out of submitting, no double submit, no skipping payment

// Persist `step` in the URL so refresh does not lose the flow
// /checkout?step=payment
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • R49
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Use a portal for modals, tooltips and popovers that must not be clipped by an ancestor. The component still belongs to its parent in React, so context and event bubbling work as written.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Which means a click inside a portalled modal will trigger an onClick on its React parent, even though the DOM nodes are nowhere near each other.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Portal, and the bubbling surprise
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      function Modal({ children, onClose }) {
  return createPortal(
    <div className="overlay" onClick={onClose}>
      <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
           onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>{children}</div>
    </div>,
    document.body            // escapes overflow/z-index of the parent
  )
}

// The surprise: this fires even though the DOM nodes are siblings
<div onClick={handleParentClick}>
  <Modal>...</Modal>          // clicks inside still bubble to here
</div>

// Escape hatches, ranked by how much you should want them:
// portal (fine) > ref to a DOM node (fine) >
// useImperativeHandle (narrow API) > reaching into a child (no)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • R50
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The single highest-value TypeScript pattern in React is modelling async state as a union rather than a bag of flags. You physically cannot have loading and error at once, and TS narrows the data field for you.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Beyond that: type the props, not the component, and reach for the built-in helpers rather than redeclaring DOM types.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Impossible states, made impossible
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        // BAD - 16 combinations, 12 of them meaningless
{ loading: boolean; error?: Error; data?: User; empty: boolean }

// GOOD - exactly 4 states, and data only exists in one
type State =
  | { status: 'idle' }
  | { status: 'loading' }
  | { status: 'error';   error: Error }
  | { status: 'success'; data: User }

if (s.status === 'success') s.data.name   // narrowed, no ?. needed

// Useful prop types
type Props = {
  children: React.ReactNode
  onClick: React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>
} & React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'button'>   // inherit all button props

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • R51
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The flame graph shows what rendered in one commit and how long each part took; the ranked chart sorts by cost. The profiler also tells you why each component rendered — props, state, hooks, or parent.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Measure a production build. Development React is several times slower and will send you chasing the wrong component.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The workflow
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1. DevTools > Profiler > gear > "Record why each component rendered"
2. Components tab > gear > "Highlight updates when components render"
3. Record the slow interaction, then read:

   FLAME GRAPH   what rendered in this commit, width = time
   RANKED        same commit, sorted by cost - start here
   "Why did this render?"  props / state / hooks / parent

4. Then decide:
   many components, each fast  -> stop the cascade (memo, selectors)
   one component, slow         -> optimise that component
   few renders, still janky    -> not React; check the main thread

// Always profile a PRODUCTION build.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Saved links

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • R52
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Too many renders is a subscription problem — memo, split context, narrower selectors. A slow single render is an algorithmic problem — virtualise, memoise the expensive computation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            If React is fast but the page still stutters, the culprit is a long task: a big JSON parse, a sort over 50,000 rows, an image decode. That belongs off the main thread.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Diagnosing the right one
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            SYMPTOM                         CAUSE                FIX
100 components render on one    subscription too     memo, split
keystroke, each 0.2ms           broad                context, selectors

1 component takes 400ms         doing too much       virtualize,
                                                     useMemo, paginate

React is fast, page still       long task blocking   web worker,
janky (Performance tab shows    the main thread      chunk the work,
a 900ms yellow block)                                startTransition

// Performance tab > Long tasks (>50ms) is the ground truth.
// React Profiler cannot see work that is not React.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • R53
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A selector returning a primitive is compared with === and just works. A selector returning a new object or array is a different reference every time, so the comparison always fails and the component always re-renders.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              That is the whole game: keep selectors narrow, and when you must return a derived collection, memoise it or use a shallow comparator.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Granularity in practice
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              // Re-renders on EVERY action anywhere
const state = useSelector(s => s)

// Re-renders when the whole cart object changes
const cart = useSelector(s => s.cart)

// Re-renders only when the number changes            <- aim here
const count = useSelector(s => s.cart.items.length)

// New array every call -> always re-renders
const active = useSelector(s => s.items.filter(i => i.active))

// FIX 1 - memoised selector, recomputes only when input changes
const selectActive = createSelector([s => s.items],
                                    items => items.filter(i => i.active))
// FIX 2 - shallow comparison
useSelector(selectActive, shallowEqual)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              My notes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • R54
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The browser struggles with tens of thousands of DOM nodes. Windowing renders only the visible slice and positions it with a transform, keeping the node count constant no matter how long the list is.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Overscan is the buffer of extra rows rendered off-screen so fast scrolling does not show blank space. Variable row heights are the hard part — you need measurement and a cache.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The windowing maths
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                const H = 40                                  // row height
const start = Math.floor(scrollTop / H)
const count = Math.ceil(viewportH / H)
const first = Math.max(0, start - overscan)
const last  = Math.min(total, start + count + overscan)

<div style={{ height: total * H }}>              {/* fake scrollbar */}
  <div style={{ transform: `translateY(${first*H}px)` }}>
    {items.slice(first, last).map(i => <Row key={i.id} item={i}/>)}
  </div>
</div>

// Variable heights -> measure each row, cache it, and keep a
// running offset index. Use TanStack Virtual rather than hand-rolling.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • R55
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Without this, one expensive render blocks the input and typing feels broken. startTransition marks an update as low priority so React can pause it to handle a keystroke.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  useDeferredValue is the same idea from the other end: keep showing the previous value while the new one renders in the background.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Keeping input responsive
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  // startTransition - you control the update
const [q, setQ] = useState('')
const [list, setList] = useState([])
function onChange(e) {
  setQ(e.target.value)                    // urgent: the input
  startTransition(() => {
    setList(filterHuge(e.target.value))   // interruptible
  })
}

// useDeferredValue - you only have the value
const q = useQuery()
const deferred = useDeferredValue(q)
const results = useMemo(() => filterHuge(deferred), [deferred])
const stale = q !== deferred              // dim the list while catching up

// This does not make the work faster. It makes it INTERRUPTIBLE.
