                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • R56
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Traditional SSR renders the entire page on the server, so the response is as slow as its slowest data dependency. Streaming SSR flushes the HTML it already has and streams each Suspense boundary as it resolves.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Selective hydration then prioritises whichever part the user interacts with first — click a still-hydrating widget and React hydrates that one ahead of the queue.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Shell first, slow parts later
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    // Everything below a Suspense boundary streams in separately
export default function Page() {
  return (
    <Shell>                       {/* flushed immediately */}
      <Nav />
      <Suspense fallback={<FeedSkeleton />}>
        <Feed />                  {/* streamed when its data resolves */}
      </Suspense>
      <Suspense fallback={<AsideSkeleton />}>
        <Recommendations />       {/* independent, arrives whenever */}
      </Suspense>
    </Shell>
  )
}

TTFB       shell HTML, ~immediate
+300ms     <Feed> chunk arrives, replaces its skeleton
+900ms     <Recommendations> arrives

// Selective hydration: interacting with a region hydrates it first.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • R57
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Tree shaking only works on ES modules with no side effects. A package without sideEffects: false in its package.json is treated as unsafe to prune, so all of it ships.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Run the analyzer before optimising anything. The answer is usually two copies of one library at different versions, one enormous dependency, or a barrel file.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The four usual findings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      npx vite-bundle-visualizer      # or webpack-bundle-analyzer

1. BARREL FILE
   import { Button } from '@/components'      // pulls index.ts -> all
   import { Button } from '@/components/Button'   // deep import

2. MISSING sideEffects
   // package.json of your own shared lib
   { "sideEffects": false }        // now unused exports can be dropped
   { "sideEffects": ["*.css"] }    // keep CSS imports

3. DUPLICATE DEPENDENCY
   npm ls date-fns     # two versions -> dedupe / align / override

4. THE ONE HUGE IMPORT
   import _ from 'lodash'              // ~70KB
   import debounce from 'lodash-es/debounce'
   import { format } from 'date-fns'   // already modular
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • R58
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Good boundaries: routes, modals, editors, anything behind a feature flag, and heavy vendor libraries that only one page uses.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Bad boundaries: a component used on every page, or something so small the request costs more than the code. And name your chunks — anonymous hashes make production debugging much harder.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Where to draw the line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SPLIT                              DO NOT SPLIT
each route                         your Button
modals, drawers                    anything above the fold
rich text editor, charts, maps     a 2KB helper
admin-only sections                shared layout chrome
polyfills behind a check           React itself

// Name the chunk so it is identifiable in the network tab
const Editor = lazy(() =>
  import(/* webpackChunkName: "editor" */ './Editor'))

// Group a vendor bundle deliberately
manualChunks: {
  vendor: ['react', 'react-dom'],
  charts: ['recharts', 'd3-scale']
}

// Retry a failed chunk load - a deploy mid-session invalidates hashes
const load = (fn, n=2) => fn().catch(e => n ? load(fn, n-1) : Promise.reject(e))
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • R59
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Three vitals to know: LCP is how fast the main content appears, INP is how responsive interactions feel, CLS is how much the page jumps around while loading.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Each has a boring, well-known cause, and naming the cause is what separates a real answer from a recited definition.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The three, and their usual causes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          LCP  < 2.5s   largest element painted
     causes: slow server response, render-blocking CSS/JS,
             unoptimised hero image, client-only rendering

INP  < 200ms  interaction to next paint  (REPLACED FID in 2024)
     causes: long tasks blocking the main thread, huge re-render
             on keystroke, heavy work in an event handler
     fixes:  break up long tasks, transitions, virtualization,
             move work to a worker

CLS  < 0.1    layout shift
     causes: images with no width/height, injected banners,
             web fonts swapping metrics, ads
     fixes:  reserve space, aspect-ratio, font-display: optional
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2↗

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • R60
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Reserve the space, serve the right size for the viewport, and use a modern format. srcset lets the browser pick; loading="lazy" defers off-screen images, but never on the LCP image.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            For fonts, font-display: swap shows fallback text immediately (FOUT) instead of invisible text (FOIT) — and preloading the one critical font removes most of the swap.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Images and fonts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            <img src="hero-800.webp"
     srcset="hero-400.webp 400w, hero-800.webp 800w, hero-1600.webp 1600w"
     sizes="(max-width: 600px) 100vw, 800px"
     width="800" height="450"        /* reserves space -> no CLS */
     fetchpriority="high"            /* LCP image: do NOT lazy-load */
     alt="..." />

<img loading="lazy" decoding="async" ... />   /* below the fold */

/* Fonts */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Inter';
  src: url(/inter.woff2) format('woff2');
  font-display: swap;        /* FOUT: fallback text, then swap  */
                             /* block = FOIT: invisible text    */
  size-adjust: 105%;         /* match fallback metrics -> less shift */
}
<link rel="preload" as="font" type="font/woff2" href="/inter.woff2" crossorigin>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1↗

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • R61
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Move work to a worker when it is CPU-bound and takes long enough to be felt: parsing a large CSV, crypto, image processing, diffing big structures.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The cost is that data is copied across the boundary (unless you transfer an ArrayBuffer), so a worker is not worth it for small or chatty work.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Off the main thread
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              // worker.js
self.onmessage = (e) => {
  const rows = parseHugeCsv(e.data)      // 900ms, nobody notices
  self.postMessage(rows)
}

// component
const worker = useMemo(() => new Worker(
  new URL('./worker.js', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' }), [])

useEffect(() => {
  worker.onmessage = e => setRows(e.data)
  return () => worker.terminate()        // or it leaks
}, [worker])

worker.postMessage(csvText)

// Data is COPIED across the boundary. For big buffers, transfer it:
worker.postMessage(buf, [buf])           // zero-copy, buf unusable here

// WORTH IT: parse, crypto, image ops, diffing, compression
// NOT WORTH IT: small work, chatty back-and-forth, DOM access (none)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • R62
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                In a multi-page site a navigation wipes everything. In an SPA, a listener attached on mount and never removed survives every route change, and after an hour there are hundreds.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The tell is memory climbing steadily as you navigate. In DevTools, take a heap snapshot, navigate away, force GC, snapshot again — detached DOM nodes are the smoking gun.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The four usual leaks
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                // 1. listener
useEffect(() => {
  window.addEventListener('resize', onResize)
  return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize)
}, [])

// 2. timer
useEffect(() => {
  const id = setInterval(tick, 1000)
  return () => clearInterval(id)
}, [])

// 3. subscription / socket
useEffect(() => {
  const sub = source.subscribe(handler)
  return () => sub.unsubscribe()
}, [])

// 4. setState after unmount (async resolving late)
//    -> AbortController, or an isMounted flag

// Also: observers (Intersection/Resize) need .disconnect()

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • R63
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Budgets work because they fail the pull request that caused the regression, while the author still remembers why. Bundle size is the easy one to enforce; Lighthouse CI covers the rendered metrics.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Keep the budget per-entry rather than total, or one growing chunk hides behind everything else.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Enforcing it
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  // size-limit - fails the PR, comments the delta
{ "size-limit": [
    { "path": "dist/main-*.js",   "limit": "180 KB" },
    { "path": "dist/vendor-*.js", "limit": "140 KB" }
] }

# Lighthouse CI - rendered metrics, not just bytes
lhci autorun --assert.preset=lighthouse:recommended \
  --assert.assertions.largest-contentful-paint=2500 \
  --assert.assertions.cumulative-layout-shift=0.1

PER PR      bundle size, lint, typecheck, unit + component tests
NIGHTLY     full E2E matrix, Lighthouse on real routes, visual regression

// Track the trend, not just the threshold - a budget you keep
// raising is not a budget.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Level 5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Platform & Delivery
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Days 22-23, 26-27, 34, 39-41, 44-48
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Done whenYou can take a component from working to shippable: accessible, tested, themed, internationalized, secure, and observable.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  StudyARIA Authoring Practices Guide — patterns →react.dev — Server Components →React Testing Library — guiding principles →
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  0/23
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • R64
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    SSG builds at deploy time and is the fastest and cheapest — but a content change needs a rebuild. ISR is SSG that regenerates in the background after a TTL, which covers most content sites.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    SSR renders per request: correct for personalised or fast-changing pages, and the most expensive. CSR ships an empty shell — fine when SEO does not matter and the user is already logged in.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The decision table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                BUILT       SEO    PERSONALISED   COST     USE FOR
CSR         browser     poor   yes            lowest   dashboards,
                                                       internal tools
SSG         build time  best   no             lowest   docs, marketing,
                                                       blog
ISR         build +     best   no             low      catalogues,
            revalidate                                 news
SSR         per request best   yes            highest  personalised
                                                       pages that
                                                       must rank
STREAMING   per request best   yes            high     SSR where one
   SSR                                                 query is slow

Ask in order:
  1. Does a search engine need it?        no  -> CSR is allowed
  2. Is it per-user?                      yes -> SSR
  3. How stale can it be?    minutes -> ISR   seconds -> SSR
  4. Is one data source slow?             yes -> stream it
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • R65
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Hydration is the cost of SSR: you ship the HTML and the JavaScript, and the page looks ready before it actually responds to clicks.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Mismatches come from rendering anything that differs between server and client — dates, random values, window, localStorage. Render the server-safe version first, then update in an effect.
