                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Fixing a mismatch
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      // MISMATCH - server has no window, client does
<div>{window.innerWidth}</div>

// MISMATCH - different clock, different timezone
<div>{new Date().toLocaleString()}</div>

// FIX - render a stable value, correct it after mount
const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
useEffect(() => setMounted(true), [])
return <div>{mounted ? localTime() : serverTime}</div>

// Or skip SSR for that subtree entirely
const Chart = dynamic(() => import('./Chart'), { ssr: false })
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • R66
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A server component can talk to the database directly and its code never reaches the bundle. A client component is what you already know — it has state, effects and event handlers, and it costs bundle size.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Everything is a server component by default; you opt into the client with use client. Props crossing the boundary must be serialisable, so you cannot pass a function down.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The boundary rules
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        // app/page.tsx  - server component (default)
import Chart from './Chart'          // client component
export default async function Page() {
  const rows = await db.query(...)   // runs on the server only
  return <Chart data={rows} />       // data must be serializable
}

// Chart.tsx
'use client'                          // opt into the browser
export default function Chart({ data }) {
  const [sel, setSel] = useState(null)   // hooks need this directive
}

RULES
  server -> can render client        client -> cannot import server
  props across the boundary must be serializable (no functions)
  no useState/useEffect/onClick in a server component
  a client component's children CAN be server-rendered (pass as slot)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • R67
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Three stores, three jobs: localStorage for tiny synchronous preferences, IndexedDB for structured data of any size (async, no blocking), and the Cache API via a service worker for HTTP responses and offline assets.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Size limits and eviction differ, and all three can be cleared by the browser or the user — so treat every one as a cache, never as a source of truth.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Picking the right one
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          localStorage       ~5MB   SYNCHRONOUS, strings only
                   theme, last-used filter, feature flag, UI prefs
                   NOT tokens (XSS reads it), NOT large data

IndexedDB          ~GBs   async, structured, indexed, transactional
                   offline records, drafts, cached lists
                   use idb / Dexie - the raw API is unpleasant

Cache API (SW)     ~GBs   HTTP request/response pairs
                   assets, offline shell, API response caching

Cookies            4KB    sent with every request
                   auth (httpOnly + Secure + SameSite), not app state

// Every read must survive being empty or throwing
try { const v = localStorage.getItem(k) } catch { /* private mode */ }
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • R68
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The architecture is a local write queue: apply the change locally, queue it, and replay when the connection returns. The service worker Background Sync API can do the replay even if the tab is closed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Then decide the conflict rule up front — last-write-wins loses data silently, so anything important needs versions and either a merge or a user prompt.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Queue, replay, resolve
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            // 1. Write locally first, queue the mutation
await db.put('orders', { ...order, _dirty: true, _rev: order.rev })
await db.add('outbox', { id, method:'PUT', body: order })

// 2. Replay on reconnect (idempotency key so retries are safe)
window.addEventListener('online', flushOutbox)
// or Background Sync - runs even if the tab was closed
registration.sync.register('outbox')

// 3. Conflict resolution - decide BEFORE you need it
LAST WRITE WINS      simplest, silently destroys the other edit
VERSION + REJECT     server returns 409, client re-fetches and retries
FIELD MERGE          merge per field; only works for disjoint edits
CRDT                 converges automatically, real complexity cost
ASK THE USER         honest for documents; unacceptable per keystroke

// Send the version you based the edit on:
PUT /orders/1  If-Match: "rev-7"   ->  409 if the server moved on
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • R69
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Pick the cheapest thing that works: polling for slow-changing data, SSE for a server-driven stream like notifications or progress, WebSocket only when the client also needs to push continuously — chat, presence, collaborative editing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Whatever you choose, the hard part is not connecting. It is what happens after a reconnect: you missed messages, and you need a cursor to catch up.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Choosing, and reconnecting properly
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              POLLING     simple, cacheable, works everywhere; latency = interval
SSE         one-way, auto-reconnect, plain HTTP, ~6 conn/domain limit
WEBSOCKET   two-way, low latency, you own reconnect + heartbeat

// The part people forget: resume from where you left off
let lastId = null
function connect() {
  const ws = new WebSocket(`${url}?since=${lastId ?? ''}`)
  ws.onmessage = e => { const m = JSON.parse(e.data); lastId = m.id; apply(m) }
  ws.onclose = () => setTimeout(connect, backoff())   // + jitter
}

// backoff with jitter, capped
const backoff = () => Math.min(30000, 1000 * 2 ** n) * (0.5 + Math.random())
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • R70
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Collect incoming messages into a ref (which does not trigger renders), then commit the batch on the next animation frame. One render per frame instead of hundreds.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For a live-updating list, also cap what you keep in memory — an append-only array from a firehose is a memory leak with a nice UI on top.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Buffer and flush on rAF
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                const buffer = useRef([])
const frame = useRef(null)

function onMessage(msg) {
  buffer.current.push(msg)              // no render
  if (frame.current) return             // already scheduled
  frame.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    frame.current = null
    const batch = buffer.current
    buffer.current = []
    setRows(prev => [...batch, ...prev].slice(0, 500))   // cap memory
  })
}

useEffect(() => () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame.current), [])

// 500 msg/s + naive setState  -> 500 renders/s, unusable
// buffered on rAF            -> <=60 renders/s, smooth

// Pair with virtualization: 500 rows in state, ~20 in the DOM.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • R71
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Use the semantic element and you get the role, keyboard behaviour and focus handling for free. A div with an onClick has none of that, and reproducing it takes ARIA plus tabindex plus key handlers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ARIA is for when no native element fits. The first rule of ARIA is not to use ARIA.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Native first
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  // Nothing works: not focusable, no role, no Enter/Space
<div onClick={save}>Save</div>

// Everything works, for free
<button onClick={save}>Save</button>

// If you truly must, you are reimplementing the browser:
<div role="button" tabIndex={0} onClick={save}
     onKeyDown={e => (e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ') && save()} />

ACCESSIBLE NAME comes from, in order:
  aria-labelledby > aria-label > content > title
<button aria-label="Close">&times;</button>   // icon-only needs this

// Test the way a screen reader reads it
getByRole('button', { name: /save/i })
// If this query fails, assistive tech cannot find it either.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • R72
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Three obligations for any overlay: move focus in on open, keep it inside while open, and return it to the trigger on close. Plus Escape to dismiss.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The modern shortcut is the native <dialog> element with showModal(), which does the trapping and the inert backdrop for you.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The full contract
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    function Modal({ onClose, children }) {
  const ref = useRef(null)
  const opener = useRef(document.activeElement)   // remember the trigger

  useEffect(() => {
    ref.current?.querySelector('[autofocus],button,input')?.focus()
    return () => opener.current?.focus()          // restore on close
  }, [])

  return (
    <div ref={ref} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="t"
         onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Escape' && onClose()}>
      <h2 id="t">Title</h2>{children}
    </div>
  )
}

// Native version does trapping + inert background for you
<dialog ref={d} onClose={onClose}>...</dialog>
d.current.showModal()

// Outside a native dialog, mark the rest inert:
<main inert={isOpen ? '' : undefined}>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • R73
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The pattern that trips people up is roving tabindex: only one item in a menu is tabbable, and the arrow keys move that tabbability. Tab should exit the whole widget, not walk through every item.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      These contracts are written down in the ARIA Authoring Practices Guide. Follow it, or use a headless library that already has.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The contracts worth memorising
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      MENU / LISTBOX
  Arrow Up/Down   move active item (roving tabindex)
  Home / End      first / last
  a-z             typeahead to matching item
  Enter / Space   select
  Escape          close, focus returns to the trigger
  Tab             LEAVE the widget entirely

COMBOBOX  (input + popup)
  focus stays in the INPUT the whole time
  aria-activedescendant points at the highlighted option
  Arrow opens + moves, Enter selects, Escape closes then clears

DIALOG
  focus moves in, is trapped, returns on close; Escape closes

TABS
  arrows move between tabs; Tab goes into the panel

// Roving tabindex - exactly one item is tabbable
<li tabIndex={i === active ? 0 : -1} />
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      My notes
