                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • R74
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        aria-live="polite" waits for a pause and is right for status messages; assertive interrupts and should be reserved for errors that block the user.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The region must exist in the DOM before the text appears — inserting the element and its content at the same time is often not announced at all.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Announcing async results
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        // The container must be present from the start, EMPTY
<div aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" className="sr-only">
  {status}                       {/* announced when this changes */}
</div>

// Rendering the whole thing at once often announces nothing:
{status && <div aria-live="polite">{status}</div>}   // unreliable

role="status"  = aria-live="polite"    saved, 3 results found
role="alert"   = aria-live="assertive" validation failed, session expired

// Visually hidden but readable
.sr-only { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden;
           clip-path:inset(50%); white-space:nowrap }

// Loading states need announcing too
<div role="status">{isLoading ? 'Loading results' : `${n} results`}</div>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • R75
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Intl is built into the browser and handles dates, numbers, currency, relative time and plural rules without a library. Plural categories are not just one/many — several languages have three or more.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          For RTL, use CSS logical properties (margin-inline-start) instead of left/right and the layout mirrors itself.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Intl and logical properties
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          // WRONG - assumes English word order, breaks in translation
<>{count} {count === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'} in your {name} cart</>

// RIGHT - one message, placeholders, plural rules from the locale
t('cart.summary', { count, name })
// en: "{count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} in your {name} cart"

new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style:'currency', currency:'INR' }).format(n)
new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { dateStyle:'medium' }).format(d)
new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(locale).format(-3, 'day')    // "3 days ago"
new Intl.PluralRules(locale).select(2)                   // "few" in some

/* RTL for free */
margin-inline-start: 8px;   /* not margin-left */
padding-inline: 12px;
text-align: start;          /* not left */
<html dir={isRtl ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'} lang={locale}>
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • R76
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The classic bug: a report labelled today computed from the browser clock, so a user in a different zone sees different numbers for the same day.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Dates without times (a birthday, an invoice date) should never be timestamps at all — store them as plain calendar dates or they shift a day when converted.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            UTC in, zone at the edge
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            // Store and compute in UTC
createdAt: '2026-08-30T14:05:00Z'

// Render in an EXPLICIT zone, never the implicit browser one
new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-IN', {
  timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata',        // the business zone, stated
  dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short'
}).format(new Date(createdAt))

// BUG - "today" depends on where the user is sitting
const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)

// FIX - ask for the day in the zone that defines the business day
const today = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',
  { timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' }).format(new Date())   // YYYY-MM-DD

// Calendar dates are NOT timestamps
birthday: '1994-03-12'      // plain string, never a Date
// new Date('1994-03-12') is UTC midnight -> 11 March in some zones
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • R77
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Custom properties cascade and can be redefined per theme, so switching themes needs no JavaScript re-render at all.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The dark mode flash happens because the page paints with the default theme before your JS reads the stored preference. Fix it with a tiny blocking script in the head that stamps the theme before first paint.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Tokens and no FOUC
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              /* raw scale */
:root { --blue-600:#2563eb; --grey-900:#111827; --grey-50:#f9fafb }

/* semantic layer - the only thing components use */
:root { --bg:var(--grey-50); --fg:var(--grey-900); --accent:var(--blue-600) }
:root[data-theme="dark"] { --bg:var(--grey-900); --fg:var(--grey-50) }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) { --bg:var(--grey-900); --fg:var(--grey-50) }
}
.card { background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg) }   /* never --grey-900 */

<!-- No flash: runs BEFORE first paint, in <head>, not deferred -->
<script>
  try { var t = localStorage.getItem('theme')
        if (t) document.documentElement.dataset.theme = t } catch {}
</script>

/* Three states: explicit light, explicit dark, and system default */

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2↗

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • R78
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                {userInput} is escaped and cannot execute. The danger is dangerouslySetInnerHTML, and the less obvious one: a user-supplied string used as a URL, because javascript: is a valid URL scheme.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                If you must render user HTML, sanitise it with DOMPurify on the way in, and back it up with a Content Security Policy so an injection still cannot execute.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The three ways out of safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                // SAFE - escaped
<div>{userInput}</div>

// 1. RAW HTML
<div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: userHtml }} />
// -> DOMPurify.sanitize(userHtml) first, always

// 2. URL AS A PROP - javascript: is a valid scheme
<a href={userUrl}>                      // <a href="javascript:...">
const safe = /^https?:\/\//.test(userUrl) ? userUrl : '#'

// 3. SPREADING UNKNOWN PROPS
<div {...userSuppliedProps} />          // can inject onError, href...

// Defence in depth: CSP with a nonce, no unsafe-inline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • R79
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  CSRF exists because the browser attaches cookies to cross-site requests automatically. SameSite=Lax blocks most of it; a token in a custom header covers the rest, since another origin cannot set headers on a cross-site form post.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The common compromise is a short-lived access token in memory plus a refresh token in an httpOnly cookie — XSS cannot read the refresh token, and the access token dies quickly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Storage and CSRF
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  STORAGE
  localStorage        readable by ANY XSS                  avoid for tokens
  memory (a variable) lost on refresh, safe from XSS       good for access
  httpOnly cookie     JS cannot read it; sent automatically -> needs CSRF

// Recommended shape
Set-Cookie: refresh=...; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/auth
// access token lives in memory only, ~15 min, refreshed silently

// CSRF defence with cookie auth
Set-Cookie: session=...; SameSite=Lax; Secure; HttpOnly   // first line
X-CSRF-Token: <token>          // double-submit; cross-origin JS
                               // cannot set custom headers

// Silent refresh - one in-flight refresh, queue the rest
let pending = null
const refresh = () => (pending ??= fetch('/auth/refresh')
  .finally(() => { pending = null }))
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • R80
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Testing Library pushes you toward querying the way a screen reader would, which means your tests double as an accessibility check. If you cannot find a button by its role and name, neither can an assistive technology.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Mock at the network boundary with MSW rather than stubbing your fetch functions — then the test exercises the real code path including error handling.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Query priority and MSW
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    // PREFER, in this order
getByRole('button', { name: /save/i })   // best - a11y tree
getByLabelText('Email')
getByText('No results')
getByTestId('row-3')                     // last resort

// AVOID: container.querySelector('.btn-primary')

// Mock the network, not your own modules
const server = setupServer(
  http.get('/api/orders', () => HttpResponse.json([{ id: 1 }]))
)

test('shows an error when the request fails', async () => {
  server.use(http.get('/api/orders', () => new HttpResponse(null, {status:500})))
  render(<Orders />)
  expect(await screen.findByRole('alert')).toHaveTextContent(/failed/i)
})
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • R81
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Test a handful of critical user journeys end to end, not every screen. E2E is slow and brittle; the pyramid still applies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Visual regression catches the CSS changes that assertions cannot, but it needs consistent rendering — run it in a container, freeze animations and dates, or you will approve diffs every week.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Killing flake
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      // FLAKY - a race with the network dressed up as a test
await page.waitForTimeout(2000)
expect(await page.textContent('.total')).toBe('3')

// STABLE - waits for the condition, with a timeout as a backstop
await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toHaveText('3 items')

THE USUAL CAUSES
  fixed waits              -> web-first assertions that auto-retry
  shared test data         -> create fresh data per test, run isolated
  animations mid-assert    -> disable them in the test build
  real time / real network -> freeze the clock, stub the network
  test order dependence    -> each test sets up its own state

// Visual regression needs determinism
await page.addStyleTag({ content: '*{animation:none!important;
                                     transition:none!important}' })
await page.clock.setFixedTime(new Date('2026-01-01'))

// Quarantine, do not disable: a muted test is a deleted test.
