                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • R82
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The split is by feedback value per second: anything that catches a mistake the author just made goes on the PR. Anything that catches cross-browser or long-tail issues can wait for the night run.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Run only what the change touched where you can, and cache dependencies and build output aggressively.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The split
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        PER PR   (target < 10 min, runs in parallel)
  typecheck            tsc --noEmit
  lint                 eslint (changed files)
  unit + component     vitest / jest, affected only
  build                catches import and env errors
  bundle size          size-limit, fails on regression
  E2E smoke            3-5 critical journeys, one browser

NIGHTLY / PRE-RELEASE
  full E2E matrix      all browsers, mobile viewports
  Lighthouse CI        on real routes, budgets asserted
  visual regression    full page set
  a11y sweep           axe across every route
  dependency audit     npm audit, licence check

# Cache aggressively
- uses: actions/setup-node@v4
  with: { cache: 'npm' }
- run: npx turbo run test --filter=...[origin/main]   # affected only
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • R83
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Prefer composition over configuration: let consumers pass elements in rather than adding a boolean for every variation. Forward refs and spread the rest of the props so your components behave like the DOM elements they wrap.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Version with real semver and ship a codemod for anything breaking. If migrating is manual, teams pin the old version and you now maintain two.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          API that survives
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          // CONFIGURATION - grows forever, every case needs a new prop
<Card title="x" subtitle="y" showIcon iconName="user" headerRight={...}
      dense bordered elevated collapsible defaultOpen />

// COMPOSITION - consumers extend it without you
<Card>
  <Card.Header>
    <Avatar />  <h3>x</h3>  <Menu />
  </Card.Header>
  <Card.Body>...</Card.Body>
</Card>

// Behave like the element you wrap
const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, Props>(
  ({ variant='primary', ...rest }, ref) =>
    <button ref={ref} className={cx(variant)} {...rest} />)

// Deprecate, then remove - never both at once
/** @deprecated use `variant="primary"` - removed in v3 */
primary?: boolean

v1.2.0  add a prop            minor
v2.0.0  rename/remove a prop  MAJOR + codemod + one release of overlap
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • R84
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The costs are real: shared dependency version skew, duplicated React in the bundle, cross-app routing and auth, and debugging that spans repos. The benefit is independent deployment for teams that need it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A modular monolith with clear ownership boundaries gets you most of the autonomy with a fraction of the complexity. Try that first.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Cost and the honest threshold
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            // Module Federation - the host loads a remote at runtime
new ModuleFederationPlugin({
  name: 'shell',
  remotes: { checkout: 'checkout@https://cdn/checkout/remoteEntry.js' },
  shared: {
    react:       { singleton: true, requiredVersion: '^18.2.0' },
    'react-dom': { singleton: true, requiredVersion: '^18.2.0' }
  }   // singleton: false -> two Reacts -> hooks break in confusing ways
})

WHAT YOU TAKE ON
  version skew across teams        shared singletons, contract tests
  duplicated vendor code           bigger total download
  cross-app routing, auth, state   a shell contract nobody owns
  a remote is down at runtime      error boundary per remote + fallback
  debugging across repos           distributed tracing, source maps

WORTH IT WHEN
  several teams, separate release cadences, weak coupling,
  and a real cost to coordinating deploys
NOT WORTH IT WHEN
  one team, or you just want folder structure -> modular monolith
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            My notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Saved links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • R85
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Three layers: error tracking for exceptions, RUM for what real users actually experience, and session replay for reproducing the ones you cannot understand.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Field data beats lab data. Lighthouse on your laptop says one thing; the p75 INP from users on mid-range Android phones says something else, and that is the number that counts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The three layers
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              // 1. ERRORS - with release + source maps, or the stack is useless
Sentry.init({
  dsn, release: process.env.BUILD_SHA,
  tracesSampleRate: 0.1,
  ignoreErrors: [
    'ResizeObserver loop limit exceeded',      // benign, very noisy
    /extension:\/\//,                          // browser extensions
    'Network request failed'                   // user went offline
  ],
  beforeSend: e => isBot(navigator.userAgent) ? null : e
})

// 2. RUM - real users, real devices, field percentiles
import { onLCP, onINP, onCLS } from 'web-vitals'
onINP(m => beacon('/rum', { name:m.name, value:m.value, route }))
// report p75, segmented by device class and connection

// 3. REPLAY - low sample rate, MASK user input by default

// Alert on: new-error rate, error rate per release, p75 INP regression
// Do not alert on: total error count (always noisy)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • R86
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Spend the first minutes on scope and constraints — who uses it, on what device, how much data, what must work offline, what must be accessible. Those answers decide rendering strategy and state architecture.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Then talk explicitly about the boring parts people skip: loading and error states, what happens on a slow network, and how you would know it broke in production.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A framework you can run in 40 minutes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1  REQUIREMENTS         5 min
   who / what device / scale / offline? / SEO? / a11y bar?
   pick 2-3 core flows and say the rest is out of scope

2  DATA + API            5 min
   the entities, the shape of the responses, pagination style,
   real-time? (poll / SSE / websocket)

3  RENDERING STRATEGY    3 min
   CSR / SSR / SSG / ISR + WHY, tied to the requirements above

4  COMPONENT ARCHITECTURE 8 min
   tree, where state lives (local / lifted / context / store),
   server state vs client state

5  PERFORMANCE           8 min
   bundle strategy, virtualization, caching, images,
   the three Core Web Vitals and what threatens each

6  RELIABILITY + UX      6 min
   loading / error / empty per region, optimistic updates,
   offline, retries

7  A11Y + I18N           3 min
   roles, keyboard, focus, live regions; locale + RTL if relevant

8  OBSERVABILITY         2 min
   errors, RUM, what you would alert on

// Say the tradeoff out loud each time. The decision matters
// less than showing you knew there was one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3↗
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                DSA Patterns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Pattern-based, not volume-based. Twenty-five patterns with the exact problems for each - roughly 170 problems total. Learn to recognize which pattern applies within the first 60 seconds, then the coding is mechanical.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                0/26
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Big-O of every operation you use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Two pointers and sliding window
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Binary search, including on the answer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Hash map counting and frequency patterns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Prefix sums
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Stack: monotonic stack, valid parentheses
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Heap: top-K and merge-K
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Linked list: reverse, cycle detection, middle
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Tree traversals: DFS orders, BFS by level
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • BST properties and validation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Graph: BFS, DFS, topological sort
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Union-Find
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Backtracking: subsets, permutations, combinations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • DP: 1-D, 2-D, and knapsack
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Intervals: merge, insert, overlap
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Sorting: when to sort first
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Tier 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Core Patterns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Days 1-27
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Done whenYou recognize the pattern from the problem statement alone, and can write its template from memory before thinking about the specific problem.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                StudyNeetCode — pattern-organized practice roadmap →VisuAlgo — algorithm visualizations →
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                0/8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • D01
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ↗
